review.notes: Full token-level diff of all 28 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown plus a fence/heading structure scan; pages 10, 11, 13, 14, 19, 21 and footnote crops of pages 1, 4, 9 were rendered and visually inspected. No code fences exist in the source. Footnote markers 1 and 2 survive in the OCR while their bodies were dropped; footnote 3 lost both marker and body; all three bodies were restored verbatim from the rendered pages. The print's own misspelling 'thr realisim' (physical p.19, RetinaGAN sentence) had been auto-corrected by OCR and was restored. Apparent droppages in the diff were resolved as figure reading-order interleaves (Figures 6-9 with Tables 1-2); the continuation sentence 'background. Since vis and edge modalities...' exists at its shuffled position in the markdown.
